phase: feasibility only; full 200 trajectories require explicit maintainer approval
selection: Frozen before observing stopping outcomes; 4 prior datasets plus 16 public real-world datasets spanning size, dimension, imbalance and classes. No replacement based on outcomes, no subsampling.
seed_status: Previously examined seeds, not independent validation
original_threshold: max(1, round((n / (particles * k_nn)) * round(es_chk * 0.1))); isolated graph: 1
multiplier_rounding: max(1, round(original_threshold * multiplier)), Python nearest integer, ties to even; multiplier 1 uses original integer unchanged
checks: After iterations 1, 11, 21, ...; best starts at 0; strictly greater metric resets counter to 0; otherwise increment; first counter > adjusted threshold fires; never enforce stopping
preprocessing: Full transductive StandardScaler after deterministic numeric median imputation and full one-hot nominal encoding (missing nominal category explicit). LabelEncoder for targets, no missing targets accepted. No row removal or subsampling. Graph built once per dataset, n_jobs=1, original PCC k_nn=10 graph.
labeling: default_rng(seed), select 3 without replacement per sorted encoded class. Reject dataset if any class has fewer than 4 nodes; do not silently change protocol.
reference: Uninterrupted full 500000-iteration accuracy on initially unlabeled nodes; labels never influence observation or hypothetical stopping decisions
classification_sampling: Predictions at exact first stopping events and each 1000 iterations plus fixed intermediate iterations. Changes and reversals refer to sampled observations only, never absence of between-sample changes.
statistics: Ten paired trajectories per dataset. Sample SD, mean, median and range; overall equal dataset weights; stop/censor rates. No per-dataset optimal multiplier selection. Iteration savings are not measured wall-clock speedups.
